name: Steve Jobs
description: A journey through destiny-shaping decisions that forged a life of innovation and ambition — but every choice can lead you to a completely different fate.

scoring.historicalSimilarity: sum of weight for historically matching choices / sum of all event weights * 100
scoring.risk: average risk score of selected choices
scoring.independence: average independence score of selected choices

ending.title: Your Fate: Innovator or Traveler of Other Lands

events.title: An Adopted Child
events.playerFact: Shortly after birth, a family adopts you and raises you in a modest home. From childhood, you have a curious and determined nature.
events.historicalFact: You were born in 1955 and soon after, a family in the San Francisco Bay Area adopted and raised you.
events.question: Do you accept the responsibility of raising this adopted child?

yes.consequence: You decide to raise the child and give them a loving home.

no.consequence: You decide not to raise the child. Their life begins with another family.

events.title: A Curious Young Mind
events.playerFact: In your teens, you become fascinated with electronics and computing machines — devices that seem to have endless possibilities. You meet someone who shares this obsession completely.
events.historicalFact: In your teens, you developed a deep interest in electronics and computers, and you found a kindred spirit who became your lifelong collaborator.
events.question: Do you collaborate with this companion?

yes.consequence: You become close friends and start building things together.

no.consequence: You continue exploring electronics on your own, most of the time pursuing your interests alone.

events.title: Dropping Out of College
events.playerFact: You enroll in a liberal arts college but soon feel that formal education is not for you. It's expensive, and your family's finances are strained.
events.historicalFact: You enrolled in Reed College but dropped out after about six months, partly due to financial pressure on your adoptive parents.
events.question: Do you stay in college and continue your studies?

yes.consequence: You stay in college and continue toward a conventional degree.

no.consequence: You leave college and begin exploring life outside the traditional education system.

events.title: The Calligraphy Class
events.playerFact: Even after dropping out of formal education, you continue attending classes that genuinely interest you. One of them is a calligraphy course — the art of beautiful writing. It has no obvious practical application, but it fascinates you.
events.historicalFact: After dropping out of college, you continued taking classes. The calligraphy course you took later influenced your company's revolutionary approach to typography and design.
events.question: Do you take this calligraphy class?

yes.consequence: You study calligraphy simply because you are fascinated by it.

no.consequence: You decide calligraphy has little practical value and pass on it.

events.title: Journey to the East
events.playerFact: In your early twenties, you feel drawn to Eastern philosophy. An opportunity arises to travel to a distant land in search of spiritual enlightenment.
events.historicalFact: In your early twenties, you traveled to India in search of spiritual enlightenment — a journey that deeply shaped your worldview and aesthetic sensibility.
events.question: Do you go on this spiritual journey?

yes.consequence: You travel and explore spirituality and different ways of thinking.

no.consequence: You stay home and focus on technology and work.

events.title: The Game Company
events.playerFact: After returning from your journey, a young video game company offers you a job. The company is small but growing, in an industry that barely exists yet.
events.historicalFact: After returning from India, you worked at Atari and became more deeply involved in the emerging personal computer scene.
events.question: Do you accept this job offer?

yes.consequence: You join the company and gain experience in the nascent gaming industry.

no.consequence: You turn down the job and look for another path.

events.title: The Computing Machine
events.playerFact: Your friend has built a working computing machine in his spare time. It's a simple device, but you immediately see that it could be more than a hobby. You see an opportunity to build something ordinary people can use.
events.historicalFact: Your collaborator designed a personal computer, and you saw the potential to turn it into a commercial product — a machine anyone could use, not just hobbyists.
events.question: Do you turn your friend's invention into a business?

yes.consequence: You decide the machine can become a real product, and you start a company with your friend.

no.consequence: You decide the machine is more of an interesting hobby than a business opportunity.

events.title: The Polished Version
events.playerFact: Your machine is gaining attention. It's still mostly a device for hobbyists, but you believe it can reach a much broader audience. You want to make it polished, accessible, and beautiful — something people would want in their homes.
events.historicalFact: The second version of your product became a huge success, helping establish your company as a major force in personal computing. It set a new standard for what a personal computer could be.
events.question: Do you invest heavily to turn your product into a polished consumer product?

yes.consequence: You focus on making the machine accessible, attractive, and successful.

no.consequence: You keep the company focused mainly on technology and hobbyists.

events.title: The Ouster
events.playerFact: Tensions rise within the company you helped build. The leadership you brought in sees things differently. Eventually, you are pushed out of the very organization you founded.
events.historicalFact: After a power struggle with the company's leadership, you were ousted from the business you had founded — a painful but ultimately liberating moment.
events.question: Do you stay in the company and fight to regain control?

yes.consequence: You remain determined to regain your influence within the company.

no.consequence: You leave the company and decide to build the next chapter of your life elsewhere.

events.title: A Fresh Start
events.playerFact: You have the freedom to build from scratch. You start a new company focused on powerful machines for professionals. Separately, you invest in a small computer graphics team working on something entirely new — storytelling with machines.
events.historicalFact: After leaving the company you founded, you built a new company to create advanced workstations, and you acquired what would become a pioneering animation studio.
events.question: Do you start a new company and invest in computer animation?

yes.consequence: You start a new company and back a graphics project that will transform both industries.

no.consequence: You choose a quieter path and avoid building another large technology company.

events.title: Life in an Orphanage
events.playerFact: You are not adopted and grow up in an orphanage. Your fate is completely different — you never gain access to technology or electronics.
events.historicalFact: History is full of stories where one decision changes a life path forever.
events.question: As a teenager, do you search for your biological family?

yes.consequence: By finding your biological family, you discover your origin story. This journey of self-discovery turns you into a **bestselling memoir writer**.

no.consequence: You run from the past and take on ordinary work, but a sense of loss stays with you forever.

events.title: Alone Among Machines
events.playerFact: You reject your companion and continue your electronics work alone. You build small projects but never form a powerful partnership.
events.historicalFact: Some talented engineers, due to a lack of collaboration, never turned big ideas into big products.
events.question: Do you decide to leave electronics behind and turn to music and art instead?

yes.consequence: Leaving electronics behind, you become a **street musician** in San Francisco and later a **well-known folk singer**.

no.consequence: You continue with electronics but never achieve success, remaining in obscurity.

events.title: An Ordinary Graduate
events.playerFact: You stay in college, study, and earn a degree. You become a professor or a clerk, living a quiet life, but you never enter the technology world.
events.historicalFact: Many talented students who stayed on traditional paths never reached their potential.
events.question: Do you decide to enter politics and become a **social activist** instead of teaching?

yes.consequence: Entering politics, you become an **influential human rights and environmental activist** and found a major non-profit organization.

no.consequence: You continue teaching, living a quiet life but never leaving a lasting impact.

events.title: Rough Design
events.playerFact: You don't take the calligraphy class and never learn about visual subtlety and typography. Your products always remain rough and unappealing.
events.historicalFact: Some technology companies, by ignoring design, never achieved market dominance.
events.question: Do you decide to switch from technology to **fashion design** and start your own clothing brand?

yes.consequence: Entering the fashion world, you create a minimalist, high-quality clothing brand that becomes recognized worldwide.

no.consequence: You continue in technology, but your products never achieve good design and your company remains small.

events.title: The Soulless Entrepreneur
events.playerFact: You reject the spiritual journey and focus entirely on business. You become wealthy, but your deep aesthetic and human sensibility never develops.
events.historicalFact: Some successful entrepreneurs, by neglecting spirituality and art, never achieved true genius.
events.question: Do you use your wealth to pursue **political power** and enter international arms dealing?

yes.consequence: With wealth and influence, you become an **arms dealer in Africa**, involved in billion-dollar contracts with African governments.

no.consequence: You stay in business and die wealthy, but there was never any soul in your work.

events.title: Lost in the Industry
events.playerFact: You turn down the game company job and drift into scattered work. You never enter the personal computing industry and miss the golden opportunity.
events.historicalFact: The history of industry is full of those who ignored early opportunities and later regretted it.
events.question: Do you decide to leave technology behind and become a **chef**, opening a famous restaurant?

yes.consequence: With creative cooking, you become a **renowned chef** and your restaurant becomes a destination for tourists.

no.consequence: You stay in scattered work and never achieve success.

events.title: The Unknown Inventor
events.playerFact: You don't turn your friend's computing machine into a business. He develops it alone, but without your marketing and vision, it never achieves commercial success.
events.historicalFact: Some great inventions never reached the market due to the lack of a proper entrepreneur.
events.question: Do you decide to become a **screenwriter** and enter Hollywood?

yes.consequence: Writing science fiction screenplays, you become a **famous Hollywood screenwriter**, writing several blockbuster films.

no.consequence: You remain in obscurity and never achieve success.

events.title: A Product for Elites
events.playerFact: You keep your machine only for hobbyists and specialists. You never think about simplicity and beauty, and your competitors take the consumer market.
events.historicalFact: Some technology companies, by focusing on specialists, lost the massive consumer market.
events.question: Do you decide to switch to **visual arts** and open an art gallery?

yes.consequence: By opening a gallery, you become one of the **largest contemporary art collectors** and your name becomes immortal in the art world.

no.consequence: You stay in technology but never grow, and your company remains small.

events.title: The Power Fight
events.playerFact: You don't leave the company and fight to regain control. You spend years in political battles, draining your energy. Eventually, the company collapses, and you go down with it.
events.historicalFact: Some founders, unable to let go, drove their companies to ruin.
events.question: After the company's collapse, do you become an **organic farmer** and start a simple life?

yes.consequence: Leaving the technology world, you become an **organic farmer** in California and begin a simple, peaceful life.

no.consequence: You remain in frustration and bitterness, never finding peace.

events.title: A Quiet Life
events.playerFact: After the ouster, you decide to retire from technology. You engage in quieter pursuits and never return to the industry.
events.historicalFact: Some great entrepreneurs, after a failure, never returned, and history passed them by.
events.question: In retirement, do you travel the world and explore different cultures?

yes.consequence: Traveling to different countries, you become a **travel writer** and write bestselling books.

no.consequence: You stay at home and live a quiet life, but never make an impact on the world.

events.title: Triumphant Return
events.playerFact: After years, you return to your original company and save it from bankruptcy. With the iPhone, iPod, and iMac, you transform the world again. Your name is recorded as the greatest innovator of the century.
events.historicalFact: Steve Jobs returned to Apple in 1997 and introduced revolutionary products like the iMac, iPod, and iPhone.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this triumphant return, despite the cancer?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing your name will remain forever in the history of technology.

no.consequence: You regret the shortness of life, wishing you had more time to innovate.

events.title: Bestselling Memoirist
events.playerFact: By searching for your biological family, you discover your origin story. This journey of self-discovery inspires you to write a bestselling memoir. Your book is read worldwide and makes you a **famous author**.
events.historicalFact: Some adopted individuals, by writing self-discovery memoirs, achieved fame.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this new life as an author?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing your story has inspired many other adopted individuals.

no.consequence: You regret the lost technology path, wishing you had pursued invention instead of writing.

events.title: An Ordinary Clerk
events.playerFact: Running from the past, you become a simple clerk in an office. Your life is quiet, but a sense of loss never leaves you.
events.historicalFact: Some adopted individuals never found their roots and remained in obscurity.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this anonymous life?

yes.consequence: You live peacefully, but you know the world will never remember your name.

no.consequence: You regret the past, wishing you had searched for your roots instead of running away.

events.title: Folk Singer
events.playerFact: Leaving electronics behind, you became a street musician in San Francisco. Your unique voice and deep lyrics caught the attention of a music producer, and you soon became a **well-known folk singer**.
events.historicalFact: Some artists, by switching from technology to music, achieved success.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this artistic life?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing that even if you didn't build computers, your music touched thousands of hearts.

no.consequence: You regret the lost technology, wishing you had pursued invention instead of music.

events.title: The Unknown Lone Wolf
events.playerFact: You continue with electronics but never achieve success. Your small projects never become great products, and your name fades into obscurity.
events.historicalFact: The history of technology is full of unfulfilled talents who never achieved fame.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this anonymity?

yes.consequence: You live peacefully, but you know the world will never remember your name.

no.consequence: You regret the lost opportunities, wishing you had sought partnership instead of going it alone.

events.title: Human Rights Activist
events.playerFact: Entering politics, you became an influential human rights and environmental activist. You founded a non-profit organization that operates worldwide, and your name is recorded alongside history's greatest activists.
events.historicalFact: Some intellectuals, by entering social activism, left a lasting impact on the world.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this social impact?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing that even if you didn't build technology, you made the world a better place.

no.consequence: You regret the lost technology, wishing you had pursued innovation instead of politics.

events.title: The Forgotten Professor
events.playerFact: You teach for years and never leave a lasting impact. Your students remember you as an average professor.
events.historicalFact: Some professors never achieved fame and remained in obscurity.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this academic life?

yes.consequence: You live peacefully, but you know you never made an impact on the world.

no.consequence: You regret the lost opportunities, wishing you had pursued entrepreneurship instead of teaching.

events.title: Fashion Designer
events.playerFact: Entering the fashion world, you created a minimalist, high-quality clothing brand that became recognized worldwide. Your name stands alongside the greatest fashion designers.
events.historicalFact: Some entrepreneurs, by switching to the fashion industry, achieved global success.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this artistic-commercial life?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing that even if you didn't build computers, you changed the lifestyle of millions.

no.consequence: You regret the lost technology, wishing you had pursued innovation instead of fashion.

events.title: The Designless Engineer
events.playerFact: Your products never achieve good design and your company remains small. Your competitors, with beautiful products, capture the market and you are left behind.
events.historicalFact: The history of technology is full of companies that failed due to poor design.
events.question: Do you regret this design failure?

yes.consequence: You regret the lost days, wishing you had paid attention to aesthetics.

no.consequence: You live with pride, believing function is more important than beauty — unaware that design was the key to your competitors' success.

events.title: Arms Dealer
events.playerFact: With wealth and influence, you became an arms dealer in Africa. You have billion-dollar contracts with African governments, and your name is famous in the world of arms trading. Though your conscience is never at peace.
events.historicalFact: The history of arms trading is full of controversial figures who used money to gain political power.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this financial power, despite the guilt?

yes.consequence: You live with accumulated wealth but an empty heart, knowing your name will be recorded in history as a ruthless trader.

no.consequence: Regretting the past, you leave the arms trade and turn to peaceful activities.

events.title: Successful Investor
events.playerFact: You stay in business and die wealthy, but there was never any soul in your work. Your name is known in the investment world, but no one remembers you as an innovator.
events.historicalFact: Some investors, despite their wealth, never left a lasting impact on the world.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this wealth, despite the lack of innovation?

yes.consequence: You live with wealth and comfort, but you know you never made an impact on the world.

no.consequence: You regret the lost innovation, wishing you had pursued creativity instead of investment.

events.title: Renowned Chef
events.playerFact: With creative cooking, you became a renowned chef. Your restaurant is listed among the world's best, and your name stands alongside the greatest chefs in history.
events.historicalFact: Some entrepreneurs who failed in technology, by switching to the food industry, achieved global success.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this new life, despite leaving technology?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing that even if you didn't build computers, you showed your art in the kitchen.

no.consequence: You regret the lost technology, wishing you had pursued innovation instead of cooking.

events.title: The Industry Wanderer
events.playerFact: You stay in scattered work and never achieve success. You spend years in different jobs, none of which lead anywhere.
events.historicalFact: History is full of wasted talents who never reached their potential.
events.question: Do you regret this wandering?

yes.consequence: You regret the lost days, wishing you had paid attention to that early opportunity.

no.consequence: You live peacefully, believing fate had other plans — but you know you missed a big chance.

events.title: Hollywood Screenwriter
events.playerFact: Writing science fiction screenplays, you became a famous Hollywood screenwriter. You've written several blockbuster films, and your name stands alongside the greatest screenwriters in history.
events.historicalFact: Some people, by switching to cinema, achieved global success.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this cinematic life?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing your stories have made millions think.

no.consequence: You regret the lost technology, wishing you had pursued invention instead of screenwriting.

events.title: The Unknown Inventor
events.playerFact: You remain in obscurity and never achieve success. Your inventions are never seen, and your name fades into the darkness of history.
events.historicalFact: History is full of unknown inventors who never achieved fame.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this anonymity?

yes.consequence: You live peacefully, but you know the world will never remember your name.

no.consequence: You regret the lost days, wishing you had pursued entrepreneurship instead of hobbies.

events.title: Contemporary Art Collector
events.playerFact: By opening a gallery, you became one of the largest contemporary art collectors. Your name is immortal in the art world, and your gallery is a destination for art lovers worldwide.
events.historicalFact: Some entrepreneurs, by switching to art, achieved global success.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this artistic-commercial life?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing that even if you didn't build technology, you brought art into people's homes.

no.consequence: You regret the lost technology, wishing you had pursued innovation instead of art.

events.title: Small Company Manager
events.playerFact: You stay in technology but never grow, and your company remains small. Your competitors conquer the world and you are left on the sidelines.
events.historicalFact: The history of technology is full of small companies that never achieved success.
events.question: Do you regret this marginalization?

yes.consequence: You regret the lost days, wishing you had thought about ordinary people instead of focusing on specialists.

no.consequence: You live with pride, believing your products were for the best — though your company stayed small.

events.title: Organic Farmer
events.playerFact: Leaving the technology world, you became an organic farmer in California. You started a simple, peaceful life, and your organic products are recognized nationwide.
events.historicalFact: Some entrepreneurs, by switching to organic farming, found late peace.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this peaceful life?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing that even if you left technology, you contributed to people's health.

no.consequence: You regret the lost technology, wishing you had returned to industry instead of farming.

events.title: The Frustrated One
events.playerFact: You remain in frustration and bitterness, never finding peace. You spend years regretting the lost power, never achieving new success.
events.historicalFact: Some entrepreneurs, unable to let go, ended their lives in frustration.
events.question: Do you regret this frustration?

yes.consequence: You regret the lost days, wishing you had gone your own way instead of fighting.

no.consequence: You live bitterly, believing you were right — but the world passed you by.

events.title: Travel Writer
events.playerFact: Traveling to different countries, you became a travel writer. Your books are bestsellers and have made you a recognized figure in travel literature.
events.historicalFact: Some retired entrepreneurs, by writing travel books, achieved new fame.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this adventurous life?

yes.consequence: You live with pride, knowing that even if you left technology, you brought the world into people's homes.

no.consequence: You regret the lost technology, wishing you had returned to industry instead of traveling.

events.title: The Man at Home
events.playerFact: You stay at home and live a quiet life, but never make an impact on the world. You spend your days in your garden and your nights with memories.
events.historicalFact: Some entrepreneurs, with early retirement, never found a new life.
events.question: Are you satisfied with this quiet life?

yes.consequence: You live peacefully, but you know the world will never remember your name.

no.consequence: You regret the lost days, wishing you had sought a new mission instead of retirement.
